_doc: OSM + TIGER/Line street network (#229, user decision and download approval 2026-10-22, docs/03). vintage: the TIGER/Line year to use; a new vintage downloads into its own folder when first needed. coincide_m: a TIGER segment this close (most of its length) to an OSM way is that way, and only adds its names. snap_m: a TIGER segment end this close to an OSM node joins it there. union: false = OSM only, TIGER neither downloaded nor used (the switch, #243: run 9 found the union losing correct OSM placements on SF/LA open data; off until that is fixed). copy_m (#243): a TIGER segment this close to an OSM way of the same name, in the same direction, along half its length, is a copy of it and adds nothing. 2026-10-24 (user, #255): union on statewide (run 9C: +4,965 crashes, 0 lost / 0 flipped on hidden GPS); tiger_only_auto stays false.
